# Assessment Rules

1. The assessment was individual work.
2. Candidates were not permitted to communicate with another candidate during the assessment.
3. Candidates were not permitted to give or receive answer content or other unauthorized assistance during the assessment.
4. Candidates were not permitted to use unauthorized electronic devices or communicate with persons outside the assessment room.
5. Similar answers, common mistakes, prior study together, physical proximity, or opportunity do not by themselves establish a violation.
6. A finding must be based on the conduct prohibited by the applicable rule, using the available record.
